title: Service Timing Standard: End of the Part-Year Surrender Interest Period on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
On Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts, the last day of the part year for which surrender interest is credited depends on when the surrender is handled relative to the receipt of the signed request.

## Standard

Where the surrender is handled more than **2** days after the signed request was received, the part year of the surrender interest runs through the handling date; where it is handled one to 2 days after receipt, it runs through the day after the receipt date; where it is handled on the receipt date, it runs through the receipt date.

The part year begins at the contract's most recent interest credit; days are actual calendar days; the handling date is the day the surrender is handled.

## Table

| Handled this many days after the signed request was received | The part year runs through |
|---|---|
| 0 (handled on the receipt date) | The receipt date |
| 1 | The day after the receipt date |
| 2 | The day after the receipt date |
| 3 or more | The handling date |

## Worked cases (hypothetical: most recent interest credit 10 March, request received 25 April)

| Handled on | Days after receipt | Part year runs through | Days in the part year |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25 April | 0 | 25 April | 46 |
| 26 April | 1 | 26 April | 47 |
| 27 April | 2 | 26 April | 47 |
| 28 April | 3 | 28 April | 49 |
| 2 May | 7 | 2 May | 53 |
